subject: Post-score playbook: validation, comms, and remediation plan
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-score playbook: validation, comms, and remediation plan

Team —

Thanks for getting scores in last night. I pulled together a first-pass "post-score playbook" and an evidence bundle for each objective (see attachments). The goal is to: 1) validate contentious scores with concrete evidence, 2) finalize the narrative for QBR, 3) publish a short comms plan for managers + ICs, and 4) surface remediation actions for any red/amber objectives.

Quick asks:
- Laura: please review the evidence pack for Platform Reliability (Objective 2) — I flagged three items where scoring may be optimistic.
- Vivek: I captured two escalation asks where we might request a one-time credit / SLA exception for a partner outage. Do those look reasonable to escalate?
- Marissa/Naomi: can you take a pass on the comms draft (section C in comms-draft.md) — keep it short; managers should be able to copy/paste.

Attachments: OKR-evidence-bundle.zip (folders by objective), score-matrix-v4.xlsx, comms-draft.md

Timeline: hoping to lock language by end of day Monday so the exec QBR deck can pull final statements on Tuesday.

Thanks — I left inline comments in the score matrix.

— Diego Fernandez
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-score playbook: validation, comms, and remediation plan

Diego —

Thanks for this. Quick read and some initial reactions:

1) Platform Reliability (O2): I agree there are three spots that read optimistic. I've attached two outage timelines and the postmortem links in the Drive folder. For scoring, I think we should move O2 from "amber" to "red" for the leadership narrative and call out the partner dependency explicitly.

2) Model Quality (O1): the evidence looks solid. I suggest we keep the score but add one short mitigating bullet about the new eval harness rollout scheduled for April.

3) Remediation actions: please separate out owner vs. recommended timeline. For example, SRE should own the incident remediation, but Platform PM should own the communication to customers.

I left row-level comments in score-matrix-v4.xlsx (Tab: O2-comments).

One ask for Vivek and Diego: if we mark O2 as red, I think we should preview the ask we might take to finance (one-time credits) and legal (contractual remediation/SLAs) so the QBR slides have the 'ask' framed.

Laura
VP, Engineering Program Management
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-score playbook: validation, comms, and remediation plan

LGTM overall — good synthesis. A few leadership-level notes: 

- For the executive narrative, keep it crisp: three bullets max per objective (what we measured, net judgement, and one-line remediation/ask).
- On the O2 escalation: yes, run the scenario where we ask for a one-time credit tied to partner availability. Naomi, loop in finance/legal and surface what precedent we have.
- Comms timing: aim to send manager-facing comms the day after the exec QBR (so managers have a script before the company-wide message). That gives ops teams 48 hours to implement immediate remediations.

Also, Diego — can you add a short proposed slide for the deck: "Objective: Platform Reliability — Current State, Evidence Summary, Remediation & Ask" (one slide). I'll review after Laura's final call.

Vivek
Chief Product Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-score playbook: validation, comms, and remediation plan

Diego / team —

I ran a crisp pass on comms-draft.md. Key edits:
- Manager script: reduced to three short bullets (context, what to say to customers, immediate mitigations).
- Company blurb: softened language around "service interruption" and replaced with "intermittent degradation" for two sentences where we don't have legal signoff yet.
- Q&A: added two likely questions and short answers (SLAs, credit policy).

I've attached the edited comms-draft.md (inline below) and left comments where we need legal input.

Inline snippet (manager script):
"We experienced intermittent degradation to platform availability impacting some customers. Engineers have implemented immediate mitigations; we are working with our partner to resolve the underlying issue. We will provide an update by EOD tomorrow. If you have customers asking about credits or contractual remedies, please escalate to Sales Ops immediately."

Marissa
Head of Customer Communications
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comms-draft.md (edited)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 16:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-score playbook: validation, comms, and remediation plan

Thanks all — consolidated and updated the package. Changes made:
- O2 moved to RED with one-line justification pulled from the postmortem (timeline + partner latency impact).
- Added slide stub ("Platform Reliability: current state + asks") to the shared QBR deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_OKR_EVIDENCE (see Slide 6).
- Comms draft edited per Marissa; flagged two legal questions and a finance ask (HubSpot: HS-43872).
- Owners/timelines: converted remediation actions into a table with owners and 30/60/90 targets.

Next steps (by Monday COB):
- Laura: confirm the O2 evidence summary language (I included your postmortem link).
- Naomi: can you run finance/legal triage for the credit ask and reply-all with quick guidance?
- Marissa: prepare the manager-facing note to send day after QBR (we'll finalize on Tuesday).

I'll route the finalized one-slide ask to the exec deck after your confirmations.

Attachments: final-score-package.zip (contains updated matrix + comms-draft.md)

— Diego
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
